source: Project-authored proposal based on D2 plan; not external company policy

general.period: Half-open [start_date, end_date); no missing period is silently filled
general.region: customer.country is customer residence; invoice.billing_country is invoice billing address; equality in current snapshot does not merge meanings
general.unit: Database amount unit; no inferred USD/CNY or payment status
general.zero_denominator: Return null and explain unavailable denominator

metrics.name: 发票销售额
metrics.empty_behavior: Aggregate SUM yields NULL; presentation may say no available sales records but must not silently replace with zero
metrics.alternative: For track/artist analysis use SUM(invoice_line.unit_price * invoice_line.quantity), with invoice date filtering and no repeated SUM(invoice.total) after joining lines

metrics.name: 平均每张发票金额
metrics.alternative: 平均每位购买客户金额 = SUM(invoice.total) / COUNT(DISTINCT invoice.customer_id), kept as a separately named metric

metrics.name: 期间内复购客户数
metrics.expression: COUNT of customers with COUNT(invoice_id) >= 2 in period
metrics.limitation: Invoice records are not evidence of successful payment; crossing period bounds is not inferred

metrics.name: 热门曲目
metrics.distinct_object_rule_proposal: 曲目最受欢迎 follows purchased quantity; 客户谁买得最多 follows appendix amount definition. Generic subject-free 谁买得最多 remains unresolved; no global default is installed in D2

sql_examples.revenue_invoice: SELECT SUM(total) AS revenue FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01';
sql_examples.average_invoice: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total), 2) AS average_invoice_amount FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01';
sql_examples.repeat_customers: SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customer_count FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) AS repeat_customers;
sql_examples.popular_tracks: SELECT track_id, SUM(quantity) AS purchased_quantity FROM public.invoice_line WHERE invoice_id IN (SELECT invoice_id FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01') GROUP BY track_id ORDER BY purchased_quantity DESC, track_id ASC LIMIT 5;
sql_examples.revenue_reconciliation: SELECT (SELECT SUM(total) FROM public.invoice) AS invoice_revenue, (SELECT SUM(unit_price * quantity) FROM public.invoice_line) AS detail_revenue, (SELECT SUM(total) FROM public.invoice) - (SELECT SUM(unit_price * quantity) FROM public.invoice_line) AS difference;
sql_examples.available_dates: SELECT MIN(invoice_date) AS first_date, MAX(invoice_date) AS last_date FROM public.invoice;
